portraitAlt: Abby Jones standing holding her camera
headline: Hi, I'm Abby — so glad you're here.
lead: I'm a wedding, couples, and family photographer with a deep love for the in-between moments — the laughter mid-toast, the quiet hand on a back, the look exchanged before anyone notices.
body: I'm based in Buffalo, New York, and spend part of every year living in Germany — so whether your story is happening in Western New York, the Bavarian countryside, or somewhere in between, I'd love to be the one to tell it.
My work is bright, candid, and editorial without being stiff. I want you to feel like yourselves in front of my camera, not like you're performing. That's where the real photographs live.
When I'm not shooting, you'll usually find me exploring somewhere new with a coffee in one hand and my camera in the other — always chasing better light and quieter stories.

aboutMore.label: A Little More About Me
aboutMore.title: Because there's more to me than what's behind the camera.

family.heading: My family
text: Peyton and I met during college orientation and have been together for nearly a decade. Since then, we've gotten married, built a life together, and followed his professional hockey career — which has taken us on quite the adventure together.
And, of course, there's Oliver — our Golden Retriever and professional world traveler. Somehow, he's already traveled to more countries than most people I know.

items.title: Hockey has always been a big part of my life
items.body: I played Division I ice hockey at Penn State — and these days, I'm usually cheering on my husband, who plays professionally in Germany.

items.title: The youngest of four girls
items.body: And now the very proud aunt to four nieces and four nephews.

items.title: Pizza, always
items.body: I could genuinely eat pizza every day, at any time of day.

items.title: Always ready to go somewhere new
items.body: Travel is one of my favorite things, whether it's exploring somewhere new in Europe or heading somewhere new with my camera.
